ctx.x: I went downstairs, and I don't know how I got so to tell him to play some Spanish music, but I did -- a rumba, or something, and I got one of the entertainers and I said, 'Would you like to dance with me?' But you do what I tell you. You know.

So she says, 'Sure, come on, let's go'. And Snake Hips was in there that day, in the cabaret, and I went over there and started doing my business, I don't know what I was doing, but whatever I did, I got a lot of big hand, you know? That's whiskey doing it, though, you know -- champagne doing it.
I didn't have the tape recorder on when you told me where it was. Where did you say this was? What city was this?
